test_transform_and_run: test a Haiku module by transforming and running init then apply with a given seed
test_find_internal_python_modules: test finding all Haiku submodules under a given root module and return their names
test_find_subclasses: test recursively traversing modules to find all subclasses of a given base class
test_combined_named_parameters: test combining multiple parameterized named parameter sequences for use with absl parameterized tests
test_with_guardrails: test running a function with JAX guardrails enabled to check for unsafe JAX usage
